description: This file contains declarations for utility functions used in TensorFlow's saved model fingerprinting process, including proto serialization, chunked message processing, hashing functions for diffs, and definitions for fingerprint creation. It defines internal namespaces, data structures, and functions to support model fingerprinting and integrity verification.

methods.name: fieldTagMatches
methods.description: Compares two sequences of FieldIndex to find the length of their initial matching subsequence.

methods.name: PruneChunkedMessage
methods.description: Extracts relevant parts of a chunked message based on target field sequences.

methods.name: SerializeProto
methods.description: Serializes a protobuf message into a string.

methods.name: HashFields
methods.description: Computes a hash over specific fields within a chunked message.

methods.name: GraphDefFieldTags
methods.description: Provides the field tags for the GraphDef protobuf.

methods.name: SignatureDefFieldTags
methods.description: Provides the field tags for the SignatureDef protobuf.

methods.name: SavedObjectGraphFieldTags
methods.description: Provides the field tags for the SavedObjectGraph protobuf.

methods.name: PrunedSavedModel
methods.description: Returns a pruned SavedModel protobuf including only specified fields.

methods.name: HashMessage
methods.description: Calculates the hash of a protobuf message's selected fields.

methods.name: HashGraphDef
methods.description: Calculates the hash of a GraphDef protobuf.

methods.name: HashSignatureDef
methods.description: Calculates the hash of a SignatureDef map.

methods.name: HashSavedObjectGraph
methods.description: Calculates the hash of a SavedObjectGraph protobuf.

methods.name: HashCheckpointIndexFile
methods.description: Returns the hash of the checkpoint index file in a given model directory.

methods.name: CreateFingerprintDefCpb
methods.description: Creates a FingerprintDef protobuf from a saved model in a specified directory.
